ops.title: Widget appex CPU-burn observation (2026-07-07)
ops.body: During the 2026-07-07 stale-widget incident, the PRE-UPGRADE CCPoolStatusWidget appex (v0.43.x-era binary, pid 52415, alive since Jul 4) burned ~15 CPU-minutes in roughly the hour after its render froze (~00:17), then subsided; three later 5s `sample` runs all showed the main thread idle in mach_msg (bursts, not a hard spin). Code review of widget/Sources/Widget (Provider.swift 17-entry timeline, Views.swift, Critter.swift) found no spin-capable code — no timers, Tasks, or animation drivers; assessment: WidgetKit/chronod re-render churn against a wedged appex instance (repeated reload pokes each re-archiving 17 entries). Not fixed in Swift: no code defect identified, and the honest-staleness entry tail is deliberate. Watch for recurrence on a CURRENT binary — if a live, non-stale appex shows sustained CPU, that invalidates the churn theory and needs its own investigation. Samples archived in the incident session scratchpad (widget-appex-sample-{1,2,3}.txt); the stale-appex reap itself ships in v0.45.1 (daemon reconcileStaleWidget + doctor check).
ops.when: investigating CCPoolStatusWidget CPU usage or a stale Notification Center widget
